en.s: The Battle of Verona was fought on 30 September 489 between the Ostrogothic leader Theoderic the Great and the Germanic King of Italy Odoacer. Theoderic personally led his troops in battle, and achieved a decisive victory. Odoacer was subsequently forced to flee to Ravenna, and Theoderic was free to capture Pavia and Milan.

zh.s: 维罗纳战役于489年9月30日爆发，交战双方是东哥特领袖狄奥多里克大帝与意大利日耳曼国王奥多亚克。狄奥多里克亲自率军作战并取得决定性胜利。奥多亚克被迫逃往拉文纳，狄奥多里克随后得以攻占帕维亚和米兰。

en.s: The Battle of the Baggage (Arabic: ﻳﻮﻡ ﺍلاﺛﻘﺎﻝ, romanized: Yawm al-athqāl), was fought between the forces of the Umayyad Caliphate and the Turkic Türgesh tribes on 30 September 737. The Umayyads under the governor of Khurasan, Asad ibn Abdallah al-Qasri, had invaded the Principality of Khuttal in Transoxiana, and the local ruler called upon the Türgesh for aid.

zh.s: 驮物之战（阿拉伯语：Yawm al-athqāl）于737年9月30日爆发，交战双方是倭马亚哈里发国军队与突厥突骑施部落。呼罗珊总督阿萨德·伊本·阿卜杜拉·卡斯里率军入侵河中地区的屈底波公国，当地统治者向突骑施求援。

en.t: A magnitude 7.7 earthquake strikes the Caucasus mountains in the Seljuk Empire, causing mass destruction and killing up to 300,000 people
en.s: The 1139 Ganja earthquake was one of the worst seismic events in history. It affected the Seljuk Empire and the Kingdom of Georgia, in modern-day Azerbaijan and Georgia. The earthquake had an estimated magnitude of 7.7 MLH, 7.5 Ms and 7.0–7.3 Mw. A disputed death toll of 230,000–300,000 resulted from this event, making it one of the deadliest earthquakes ever recorded.

zh.t: 塞尔柱帝国时期高加索山脉发生7.7级地震，造成大规模破坏，最多30万人死亡
zh.s: 1139年占贾地震是历史上破坏最严重的地震之一，影响了塞尔柱帝国和格鲁吉亚王国，震中位于今阿塞拜疆和格鲁吉亚一带。估算震级为MLH 7.7、Ms 7.5、Mw 7.0至7.3。对此次地震的死亡人数估计存在争议，数字在23万至30万之间，使其成为有记录以来死亡人数最多的地震之一。

en.s: The Revolt of 1173–1174, sometimes referred to as the Great Revolt, was a rebellion against King Henry II of England led by three of his sons, his wife Eleanor of Aquitaine, and their supporters. The revolt lasted eighteen months and ended in failure; Henry's opponents were forced to submit and were ultimately reconciled with him.

zh.s: 1173至1174年叛乱又称“大叛乱”，是英格兰国王亨利二世的三个儿子、妻子阿基坦的埃莉诺及其支持者发动的起义。叛乱持续18个月，最终失败；亨利的对手被迫屈服，后来与他和解。

en.s: The battle of Morlaix was fought near the village of Lanmeur in Brittany, France, on 30 September 1342 between an Anglo-Breton army and a much larger Franco-Breton force. England, at war with France since 1337 in the Hundred Years' War, had sided with John of Montfort's faction in the Breton Civil War shortly after it broke out in 1341.

zh.s: 莫尔莱战役于1342年9月30日在法国布列塔尼的拉恩默尔村附近发生，交战双方是英布列塔尼联军与人数更多的法布列塔尼联军。英格兰自1337年起与法国交战，百年战争期间，1341年布列塔尼内战爆发后不久，英格兰便支持让·德·蒙福尔一派。

en.t: Henry IV is proclaimed king of England
en.s: Henry IV (c. April 1367 – 20 March 1413), also known as Henry Bolingbroke (having been born at Bolingbroke Castle), was King of England from 1399 to 1413, Lord of Ireland and duke of Aquitaine. Henry was the son of John of Gaunt, Duke of Lancaster, and a grandson of King Edward III. When Henry came of age, he was involved in the 1388 revolt of the Lords Appellant against his first cousin, King Richard II.

zh.t: 亨利四世被宣布为英格兰国王
zh.s: 亨利四世（约1367年4月—1413年3月20日），也称博林布鲁克的亨利（因出生于博林布鲁克城堡），于1399年至1413年担任英格兰国王、爱尔兰领主和阿基坦公爵。他是兰开斯特公爵冈特的约翰之子，也是爱德华三世国王的孙子。成年后，他参与了1388年申诉派贵族反抗其堂兄理查二世的起义。

en.s: The siege of Padua was a major engagement early in the War of the League of Cambrai. Imperial forces had captured the Venetian city of Padua in June 1509. On 17 July, Venetian forces commanded by Andrea Gritti marched quickly from Treviso with a contingent of stradioti and retook the city, which had been garrisoned by some landsknechts hired by Emperor Maximilian I.

zh.s: 帕多瓦围城战是康布雷同盟战争初期的一场重要战事。1509年6月，帝国军队攻占威尼斯城市帕多瓦；7月17日，安德烈亚·格里蒂率领威尼斯军队从特雷维索迅速出发，带领一支轻骑兵分队收复该城。此前帕多瓦由马克西米利安一世雇用的一些德意志佣兵驻守。

en.t: A coup by the military establishment of Japan's Ōuchi clan forces their lord to commit suicide, and their city is burned
en.s: The Tainei-ji incident (大寧寺の変, Taineiji no Hen) was a coup d'etat in September 1551 led by Sue Takafusa (later known as Sue Harukata) against Ōuchi Yoshitaka, hegemon and shugo daimyō of western Japan, which ended in the latter's forced suicide in Tainei-ji, a temple in Nagato Province.

zh.s: 大宁寺之变是1551年9月发生的一场政变，由陶晴贤（后称陶晴贤／陶晴方）发动，目标是日本西部霸主、守护大名大内义隆。政变迫使大内义隆在长门国大宁寺自尽。

en.s: The siege of Mount Hiei was a battle of the Sengoku period of Japan fought between Oda Nobunaga and the sōhei (warrior monks) of the monasteries of Enryaku-ji on Mount Hiei near Kyoto on September 30, 1571. It is said that Oda Nobunaga killed all the monks, scholars, priests, women, and children that lived on the mountain in this battle.

zh.s: 比叡山围城战发生于1571年9月30日，是日本战国时代的一场战斗，交战双方是织田信长与比叡山延历寺的僧兵。据称，织田信长在战斗中杀死了山上的僧侣、学者、僧人、妇女和儿童。

en.s: The Battle of Noordhorn, fought on 30 September 1581, was a pitched battle of the Dutch Revolt, fought between a Spanish army commanded by Colonel Francisco Verdugo – consisting of Walloon, German, Spanish and Albanian soldiers – and a Dutch States rebel army under the Englishman John Norreys – comprising English, Scottish, Dutch and Walloon troops – in the province of Friesland. In 1580, the Dutch stadtholder of Friesland, George van Lalaing, Count of Rennenberg, had shifted its allegiance from the Dutch to the Spanish side. This opened a new front at the back door of the Dutch Republic, forcing the States-General to dispatch forces to the north.

zh.s: 诺德霍恩战役发生于1581年9月30日，是荷兰起义期间的一场会战。西班牙军队由弗朗西斯科·贝尔杜戈上校指挥，成员包括瓦隆人、德国人、西班牙人和阿尔巴尼亚人；荷兰叛军由英国人约翰·诺里斯率领，成员包括英国人、苏格兰人、荷兰人和瓦隆人。1580年，弗里斯兰的荷兰执政官、雷嫩贝格伯爵乔治·范·拉林转投西班牙一方，使荷兰共和国后方出现新战线，三级会议因此派兵北上。

en.s: The Siege of Weissenstein took place between May 31 and September 30, 1602, during the Polish–Swedish War (1600–11). Two weeks after the capture of Fellin, Grand Crown Hetman Jan Zamoyski led the Polish-Lithuanian army of 2,000 troops to besiege Weissenstein (now known as Paide in Estonia). Weissenstein, a major transportation hub in Estonia, was a site of strategic importance to both Poland and Sweden. Located among the marshes and built during the Teutonic period, the castle had strong artillery and was defended by 700 soldiers, local peasants, and townspeople.

zh.s: 魏森施泰因围城战发生于1602年5月31日至9月30日，是波瑞战争（1600—1611年）的一部分。攻占费林两周后，大王冠盖特曼扬·扎莫厄斯基率领2000名波兰—立陶宛军队围攻魏森施泰因（今爱沙尼亚派德）。魏森施泰因是爱沙尼亚重要交通枢纽，对波兰和瑞典都具有战略价值。当地城堡建于条顿骑士团时期，周围多沼泽，火炮防御坚固，守军包括700名士兵、当地农民和居民。

en.s: The Battle of Selburg was fought during the Polish–Swedish War (1626–1629), between Sweden and the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth in September 1626. The Polish forces under Aleksander Gosiewski managed to recapture Selburg (Polish sources: Zelbork) from the Swedes earlier in 1626 and stationed their troops in the castle. In response the Swedish general Jacob De la Gardie gathered his force to once again capture the town for the Swedes.

zh.s: 塞尔堡战役发生于1626年波瑞战争期间，交战双方是瑞典与波兰—立陶宛联邦。1626年早些时候，亚历山大·戈谢夫斯基率领的波兰军队从瑞典人手中夺回塞尔堡（波兰文献称泽尔博尔克），并驻守城堡。瑞典将军雅各布·德拉加尔迪随后集结部队，准备再次为瑞典夺回该镇。

en.s: The Action of 30 September 1639 was a naval battle near Mormugão, just south of Goa, India, when a squadron of 9 Dutch ships captured and destroyed 3 Portuguese galleons. The Portuguese galleons Bom Jesus 74 and São Sebastião 50 were being careened and had their guns removed and were captured without fighting. Bom Jesus was set alight and allowed to drift toward the new galleon São Boaventura, which was refusing to surrender, causing São Boaventura to catch fire and blow up. Some of the unarmed "frigates" approached toward the end but were frightened off by the Dutch boats.

zh.s: 1639年9月30日，果阿以南的莫尔穆冈附近发生海战。九艘荷兰舰船组成的分舰队俘获并摧毁三艘葡萄牙大帆船。当时，“耶稣”号和“圣塞巴斯蒂昂”号正在维修船底，火炮也已拆下，因此未作战便被俘。“耶稣”号被点燃后漂向拒绝投降的新大帆船“圣博阿文图拉”号，导致后者起火爆炸。几艘未武装的“小型护卫舰”在战斗后段靠近，但被荷兰船只吓退。

en.s: The action of 30 September 1681 was a 2-hour fight that took place on 30 September 1681 near Cape St Vincent, and was a victory for the Spanish over Brandenburg-Prussia, which suffered 10 dead and 30 wounded.

zh.s: 1681年9月30日，西班牙和勃兰登堡—普鲁士在圣文森特角附近交战两小时。西班牙获胜，勃兰登堡—普鲁士方面有10人死亡、30人受伤。

en.s: The Battle of Madonna dell'Olmo or Battle of Cuneo was fought on the outskirts of Cuneo on 30 September 1744, in the War of the Austrian Succession. The battle ended in a victory for the armies of Spain and France over the Kingdom of Sardinia but it did not advance the victors' campaign.

zh.t: 马多娜德尔奥尔莫战役
zh.s: 马多娜德尔奥尔莫战役又称库内奥战役，于1744年9月30日在库内奥郊外爆发，是奥地利王位继承战争的一部分。西班牙和法国军队击败撒丁王国军队，但胜利并未推动联军的军事行动。

en.s: The Battle of Soor (30 September 1745) was a battle between Frederick the Great's Prussian army and an Austro-Saxon army led by Prince Charles Alexander of Lorraine during the War of the Austrian Succession. The battle occurred in the vicinity of Soor, also known as Hajnice, in the modern day Czech Republic. The battle started with a failed Austrian surprise attack on the outnumbered Prussians. Despite initial setbacks the Prussian army managed to defeat the Austrians, due to an unexpected attack from a reserve regiment that refused to follow Frederick's orders.

zh.s: 苏尔战役发生于1745年9月30日，是奥地利王位继承战争期间，腓特烈大帝的普鲁士军队与洛林亲王卡尔·亚历山大率领的奥地利—萨克森联军之间的一场战斗。战场位于今捷克境内的苏尔附近（又称哈伊尼采）。奥军突袭失败，普军虽一度陷入不利，最终仍靠一支预备团出其不意的进攻击败奥军；该团不服从腓特烈的命令，擅自发动攻击。

en.s: The siege of Namur took place between 6 and 30 September 1746, during the War of the Austrian Succession. A French army under the command of Marshal Maurice de Saxe took Namur from its Dutch garrison after a three-week siege.

zh.s: 那慕尔围城战发生于1746年9月6日至30日，是奥地利王位继承战争的一部分。莫里斯·德·萨克斯元帅率领法军围城三周后，从荷兰守军手中夺取那慕尔。

en.s: The Raid on Dartmouth (1749) occurred during Father Le Loutre’s War on September 30, 1749 when a Mi’kmaq militia from Chignecto raided Major Ezekiel Gilman's sawmill at present-day Dartmouth, Nova Scotia, killing four workers and wounding two. This raid was one of seven the Wabanaki Confederacy and Acadians would conduct against the settlement during the war.

zh.s: 达特茅斯突袭发生于1749年9月30日，是勒卢特尔神父战争期间的一次袭击。来自奇格内克托的米克马克民兵袭击了以西结·吉尔曼少校位于今新斯科舍省达特茅斯的锯木厂，造成四名工人死亡、两人受伤。这是瓦巴纳基联盟和阿卡迪亚人在战争期间对该定居点发动的七次袭击之一。

en.s: The Battle of Edgar's Lane was a skirmish in the American Revolutionary War on September 30, 1778 between a force of 80 Hessians and 120 Continental dragoons under Major Henry Lee, fought in the village of Hastings-on-Hudson, New York. Peter Post, who owned Post's Tavern, heard word of a Hessian marauding party to come through the next day. He sent word to the Continental troops, who organized a force of 120 dragoons to ambush the Hessians. When the Hessians rode through as expected the next day, Post directed them towards Edgar's Lane, where the dragoons were hidden in the surrounding trees.

zh.s: 埃德加巷战斗是美国独立战争期间的一场小规模交战，于1778年9月30日在纽约州哈德逊河畔黑斯廷斯发生。亨利·李少校率领80名黑森士兵和120名大陆军骑兵龙骑兵交战。当地人彼得·波斯特听说黑森军劫掠队第二天将经过，便通知大陆军。120名骑兵设伏；黑森军按预期经过时，波斯特把他们引向埃德加巷，那里周围树丛中藏着骑兵。

en.s: The Action of 30 September 1780 was a minor naval engagement off the Bermudas, where HMS Pearl captured the L'Espérance, a French frigate of 32 guns launched in 1779. HMS Pearl under the command of George Montagu was sent out to North America, and on 30 September 1780, soon encountered a frigate off the Bermudas. As Pearl closed Montagu cleared for action and engaged close for and maintained a running fight for two hours and more when the frigate struck. The prize turned out to be the French frigate L'Espérance of about 850 tons of thirty two guns consisting of twelve and six pounders, nearly 200 men and with a valuable cargo heading from Cape Francois to Bordeaux.

zh.s: 1780年9月30日，百慕大附近发生了一场小规模海战。英国皇家海军“珍珠”号俘获了法国护卫舰“希望”号。乔治·蒙塔古指挥“珍珠”号前往北美，很快便在百慕大附近遇到一艘护卫舰。蒙塔古下令准备交战，双方近距离交火并持续追逐两个多小时，最终对方投降。被俘的是法国“希望”号，排水量约850吨，装备32门火炮，船上近200人，还载有从法属圣多明各角运往波尔多的贵重货物。

en.t: United States Senate elections in Pennsylvania, 1788
en.s: The 1788 United States Senate election in Pennsylvania, held on September 30, 1788, was the first United States Senate election held in Pennsylvania. The Pennsylvania General Assembly, consisting of the House of Representatives and the Senate, elected Pennsylvania's first two United States Senators, William Maclay and Robert Morris.

zh.t: 1788年宾夕法尼亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚州于1788年9月30日举行美国联邦参议员选举，这是该州首次举行此类选举。由众议院和参议院组成的宾夕法尼亚州议会选出该州首批两名联邦参议员威廉·麦克莱和罗伯特·莫里斯。

en.s: The Battle of Elgsö took place on September 30, 1789, during the Russo-Swedish War (1788–1790). Sweden won over the Russian Empire. In September 1789 a Swedish force under the command of Gustaf Mauritz Armfelt, numbering 4,000 men, was sent towards Barösund where the Swedes and Russians had actively been fighting each other with ships of various sizes.

zh.s: 埃尔格瑟战役发生于1789年9月30日，是1788至1790年俄瑞战争的一部分。瑞典军队击败俄军。1789年9月，古斯塔夫·毛里茨·阿姆费尔特率领4000名瑞典士兵前往巴勒松德；瑞典和俄国舰船此前一直在该地区交战。

en.s: The 1790 Holy Roman Empire imperial election was held on 30 September in Frankfurt. The winner was Grand Duke Leopold of the House of Habsburg, who assumed the title of Holy Roman Emperor. Leopold succeeded his brother Joseph II, who died 20 February 1790. The election was uncontested, with Leopold securing unanimous support from the six voting prince-electors. The election occurred during the Great Turkish War and the early French Revolution.

zh.s: 神圣罗马帝国于1790年9月30日在法兰克福举行皇帝选举。哈布斯堡家族的利奥波德大公当选并继任神圣罗马皇帝，接替于同年2月20日去世的兄长约瑟夫二世。选举没有竞争，六名拥有投票权的选帝侯一致支持利奥波德。当时正值大土耳其战争期间，法国大革命也刚刚开始。

en.s: The Battle of the Tokhtamysh River, also known as the Battle of the Abazinka River, was a major battle between the Ottoman forces and the North Caucasians with a Russian army led by Johann Hermann von Fersen. The battle ended in a major Russian victory and forced the Ottomans and North Caucasians to flee.

zh.s: 托赫塔梅什河战役又称阿巴津卡河战役，是奥斯曼军队与北高加索军队和约翰·赫尔曼·冯·费尔森率领的俄军之间的一场重要战斗。俄军大胜，迫使奥斯曼军队和北高加索军队撤退。

en.t: The first performance of Mozart's opera The Magic Flute takes place two months before his death
en.s: The Magic Flute (German: Die Zauberflöte, pronounced [diː ˈtsaʊbɐˌfløːtə] ), K. 620, is an opera in two acts by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart to a German libretto by Emanuel Schikaneder. It is a Singspiel, a popular form that included both singing and spoken dialogue. The work premiered on 30 September 1791 at Schikaneder's theatre, the Freihaus-Theater auf der Wieden in Vienna, just two months before Mozart's death.

zh.s: 莫扎特的两幕歌剧《魔笛》（德语：Die Zauberflöte，K. 620）由埃马努埃尔·席卡内德创作德语剧本，属于兼有歌唱和对白的歌唱剧。该剧于1791年9月30日在维也纳的弗赖豪斯剧院首演，距莫扎特去世仅两个月。

en.t: France's National Constituent Assembly is dissolved, to be replaced the next day by the National Legislative Assembly
en.s: The National Constituent Assembly (French: Assemblée nationale constituante) was a constituent assembly in the Kingdom of France formed from the National Assembly on 9 July 1789 during the first stages of the French Revolution. It dissolved on 30 September 1791 and was succeeded by the Legislative Assembly.

en.s: The Battle of Melchow, one of many clashes of the January Uprising, took place on September 30, 1863, in the village of Melchow (near Lelow), which at that time belonged to Russian-controlled Congress Poland. A party of 800 Polish insurgents, commanded by Zygmunt Chmielewski, clashed with soldiers of the Imperial Russian Army. Russian losses were estimated at app. 100 killed, while Poles lost 70 killed and wounded. After the clashes near Cierno, Warzyn and Czarnca, Chmielenski concentrated insurgent units in Drochlin, where he was joined by riflemen of Captain Albert Esterhazy. When Russians found out about the insurgent camp, they sent there infantry, dragoons, Cossacks and two cannons.

zh.s: 梅乌胡夫战役是波兰一月起义期间的多场冲突之一，于1863年9月30日在梅乌胡夫村（今莱卢夫附近）发生，当时该地属于俄国控制的波兰王国。齐格蒙特·赫梅莱夫斯基率领800名波兰起义军与俄国帝国军队交战。俄军约有100人阵亡，波兰方面有70人阵亡或受伤。此前在切尔诺、瓦任和恰尔恩察附近发生冲突后，赫梅莱夫斯基在德罗赫林集结部队，艾伯特·埃斯特哈齐上尉率领的步枪兵也加入其中。俄军获悉营地后，派出步兵、龙骑兵、哥萨克和两门火炮。

en.s: Early parliamentary elections in Ukraine took place on 30 September 2007. The date of the election was determined following agreement between the President Viktor Yushchenko, the Prime Minister Viktor Yanukovych and the Chairman of the Verkhovna Rada (Ukrainian Parliament) Oleksandr Moroz on 27 May 2007, in an attempt to resolve the political crisis in Ukraine triggered by the 2 April 2007 presidential decree on dissolution of Ukraine's parliament. The 450 seats were divided among all parties that achieved a minimum 3% nationwide vote tally. The number of seats that are allocated to each party, above the 3% participation rate quota, is calculated using the Hamilton method of apportionment.

en.s: The CMLL 78th Anniversary Show was a professional wrestling major show scripted and produced by Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL) that took place on September 30, 2011 in CMLL's home arena Arena México in Mexico City, Mexico. en.s: Fighting Spirit Unleashed was a professional wrestling event promoted by New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW). The event took place on September 30, 2018, at the Walter Pyramid in Long Beach, California. It was the fifth event produced by NJPW in the United States and the first under the Fighting Spirit Unleashed branch. Wrestlers from U.S. promotion Ring of Honor (ROH) - with which NJPW has a partnership - also appeared on the card.

en.s: The 2018 Okinawa gubernatorial election was held on 30 September 2018 to elect the next governor of Okinawa. As there are no term limits in Japan, incumbent Governor Takeshi Onaga was eligible for re-election before his death in August 2018. The election was originally scheduled to be held on 9 December 2018, but this was brought forward after Onaga's untimely death.

en.s: Parliamentary elections took place in the Kurdistan Region on 30 September 2018 to elect Parliament. The election came a year after the 2017 referendum to succeed and left the ruling Kurdistan Democratic Party (KDP) with 45 seats, that positioning it to lead the next regional government. Announcement of the results was delayed for three weeks.

en.s: A coup d'état took place in Burkina Faso on 30 September 2022, removing Interim President Paul-Henri Sandaogo Damiba over his alleged inability to deal with the country's Islamist insurgency. en.s: Early parliamentary elections were held in the Slovak Republic on 30 September 2023 to elect members of the National Council. Regular elections were scheduled to be held in 2024. However, on 15 December 2022, the government lost a no-confidence vote. Subsequently, the National Council amended the Constitution so that an early election could be held on 30 September 2023. This was the first snap election in the country since 2012.

zh.s: 斯洛伐克于2023年9月30日提前举行议会选举，选出国民议会议员。原定选举在2024年举行，但政府于2022年12月15日未能通过不信任投票。此后国民议会修改宪法，允许提前选举。这是该国自2012年以来首次提前选举。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in the Maldives on Saturday, 9 September 2023, with a second round held on 30 September. Incumbent president Ibrahim Mohamed Solih was seeking re-election, after defeating the-then Speaker of the People's Majlis Mohamed Nasheed in the Maldivian Democratic Party primaries. People's National Congress candidate and Malé mayor Mohamed Muizzu won the election with 54% of the votes, defeating Ibrahim Mohamed Solih and becoming President-elect of the Maldives.
